review.notes: All nine clean compositions and the nine branded poster contact sheet reviewed. Individual scene motion sheets and all 26 one-second trailer samples reviewed with filter reinitialization disabled (end-card color metadata otherwise resets the contact-sheet filter). Full 780-frame decode passed. Titles are legible without overlap, planned cuts and desert fire/knockout appear in samples; coast portrait no longer intersects the foreground tree. Existing terrain texture patterns and cropped roadside wreck remain visible; no claim of flawless renderer output or continuous human playback.
review.audioNotes: Technical review only: complete AAC decode succeeded; 26-second original synthesized soundtrack, mean -26.5 dBFS and peak -3.6 dBFS without clipping. Fire/impact cues at9.867,11.967,13.600,14.067,14.200 seconds match authored visual-event times after scene offsets. Audio listening unavailable in this environment; no subjective listening claim.

steel-pursuit.notes: Low escort, front-side pass and overhead follow keep both tanks on the road. Foreground poles pass through the shot; portrait/square retain a cropped roadside wreck.

desert-crossfire.notes: Sunset engagement retains both vehicle tracks and three camera segments. Return fire and knockout are visible; high-contrast ground material is an existing renderer feature.

coast-recon.notes: Clear coastal patrol and low tank silhouette with sea in the first segment; full tank remains visible in portrait. Final overhead moves through the clearing.
